description: Defines the JsonValue interface representing a JSON value with methods for type checking, conversion, and serialization.

methods.name: nullLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JSON null literal.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonValue from a boolean, int, long, double, or String.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if the value is a boolean JSON literal.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if the value is a JSON number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the value is an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the value is of type long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the value is of type double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the value is a JSON string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if the value is a JSON object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the value is a JSON array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if the value is a JSON null literal.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the value as a boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the value as an int.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the value as a long.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the value as a double.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the value as a string.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the value as a JsonObject.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the value as a JsonArray.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the value.

methods.name: formatAsString
methods.description: Returns the string representation, unquoted if already a JSON string.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the value into the provided context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Provides an upper bound for the serialized size in characters.
